title: 36 Hours in São Paulo
abstract: The city’s treasures lie just below the surface: world-class restaurants, Brazil-class music and an ever-ebullient arts scene.

title: 36 Hours in Auckland
abstract: The New Zealand city is laid-back and outdoorsy, but its sophistication shines in its expanding art scene, thriving fashion industry and a new generation of chefs embracing native ingredients.

title: 36 Hours in Oaxaca
abstract: This multicultural hub in the highlands of southern Mexico is known for its mild climate, rich culinary and craft traditions, and complex history.

title: 36 Hours in Memphis
abstract: A new bike share program, museums, music and, yes, barbecue await visitors. Of special interest this spring: the commemoration of the 50th anniversary of the assassination of the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.

title: 36 Hours in Budapest
abstract: New bars, Michelin-starred restaurants and indie boutiques are enticing, but so are age-old attractions, like Buda Castle and Turkish-era thermal baths.
